#### Description
The log is `suspense.log` in Suspense's own data directory, beside `updates.log`, as the [SelfUpdateScope](../self-update/index.md#self-update-scope) keeps that one. It is one line per event, each with the time to the millisecond, the project it concerns, by its folder, or none for the application's own, and what happened. It keeps the last 20,000 lines, across sessions: each launch appends to it, and the oldest lines go once there are more.
#### Logged
It logs:
- every child process the application starts: its command, its working directory, how long it took, and its exit status, with its standard error when it failed
- each task's and question's phases as they happen, each with how long it took: queued, spec build, snapshot, preparing the container, with its mounts and the podman command, harness started, the harness's first event, each tool call, its result, and the closing snapshot
- each git status refresh, spec build, and language server start or restart, with how long it took
- any time the window was unresponsive for more than 200 milliseconds, with how long
- every panic, with its backtrace, written to the log before the application exits
#### Never Logged
It never logs environment variables, credentials, or prompt text: a command is logged with its arguments but never the prompt given on its standard input, nor anything in its environment, and a tool call by its kind and the path or command it acted on, never what the harness replied.
#### Phases
A task's history record, as the [ProjectDataScope](../project-data/index.md#project-data-scope) says, also keeps the times of its phases, as the log names them, when each began and ended, to the millisecond.
#### Collecting
The palette's "Collect debug info" writes a folder, named for the time, as `debug-2026-10-08-14-03-22`, in Suspense's data directory, and shows it in the file manager. It holds:
- `suspense.log`, the debug log
- `updates.log`
- `about.txt`, the application's version and platform
- `harness.json`, the open project's harness report
- `history/`, the history records of the open project's last ten tasks and questions, each beside its hidden anchor's source
- `README.md`, a short note saying what each file is

Suspense now keeps a debug log, `suspense.log`, beside `updates.log`, and the palette has "Collect debug info" and "Open debug log". All 548 tests pass (1 ignored) and clippy has nothing new; I haven't tried either command in the running app.
